EA Sports FC 27 adds AI-recreated voice of late commentator John Motson

Electronic Arts is bringing back the voice of the late football commentator John Motson in EA Sports FC 27, recreated using a combination of archive recordings and generative AI.

text:
Ubisoft staff must justify not using generative AI in pitches, report claims

Ubisoft teams pitching new projects are reportedly being asked to explain how generative AI would help them make games faster, and if they don't plan to use it, they have to give a detailed reason why.

Roblox signs licensing deal with PRS for Music

Roblox has struck a licensing agreement with UK music rights organization PRS for Music, opening up a new revenue stream for songwriters and composers whose work is used on the platform.

Capcom will shut down Exoprimal servers in September 2027

Capcom has announced it will end service for its online dinosaur shooter Exoprimal on September 29, 2027.

author: GamesIndustry.biz
text:
"You'd be nuts to take on all of that in the first project, and yet here we are" – How Playground is finally making good on an all-new Fable

Fable is finally set to be released on February 23, 2027, after being pushed back from its autumn 2026 launch date earlier this year, and having previously slipped from a 2025 release window. The game has been a long time coming: it was announced in 2020, but development reportedly began several years ahead of the game's official reveal.

Gaming sector to benefit from funding package of over £45m as part of Creative Industries Sector Plan

Eight games studios will share over £45 million in a government funding package with other creative sectors as part of a wider £500 million investment by UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) in the Creative Industries Sector Plan.

author: GamesIndustry.biz
text:
Analyst: Don't expect hardware price cuts until at least 2028

Manufacturers are unlikely to drop console prices until at least 2028, according to a new analysis by S&P Global Market Intelligence Kagan, which judged that planned expansions in manufacturing capacity for DRAM – a key component in gaming hardware that has rocketed in price due to the demands of the AI industry – will not come online until then.

Unreal Engine 6 won't include Blueprints or Actor Gameplay Framework

Unreal Engine 6 will discontinue support for Blueprints and the Actor Gameplay Framework, instead utilising Verse and Epic's new Scene Graph framework.
